decision_change: B0 field-generation baseline is now preregistered and machine-checkable; no B1/B2 physical acceptance margin is frozen until empirical B0 repeatability and instrument capability are observed.

bias_coordinate.assumption_class: engineering sampling design, not a physical acceptance threshold

tdcf_retention.interpretation: descriptive B0 operating-field free-charge-generation retention over the Voc-to-short-circuit prebias span; not a universal mechanism-pure quantity

pl_normalized_curve.interpretation: orthogonal descriptive bias-response curve; not converted to charge-generation yield without an independently justified model

requirements_before_freeze: instrument capability/noise characterized in same sessions
serious TDCF artifact and PL artifact explanations assessed
baseline_gate_freeze_rule.forbidden: derive B1/B2 pass threshold from v3.45/v3.55 synthetic or cross-material model values

failure_modes: TDCF apparent bias dependence caused by extraction/recombination/capacitive artifacts rather than generation
PL bias response caused by electroabsorption, heating, injection/contact effects, or recombination changes rather than exciton-to-CT generation
falsifier: If repeated B0 TDCF is flat within measured baseline repeatability across u while bias-dependent PL shows no reproducible operating-field response, a large B0 field-generation limitation is narrowed for the measured regime; conversely reproducible field dependence motivates a B1/B2 noninferiority gate frozen from these data.
synthetic_fixture_note: Synthetic fixtures only test analysis logic and are never material constants or device evidence.
